# Runtime-only native currency dependency

The designer JSP owns an unrelated initialization source, while fdDisplayJsp independently includes the known currency runtime. The existing source-to-DSL currency contract, matching typed amount/uppercase identities and exact readonly runtime binding provide a bounded value effect; a filename alone is not proof. Missing/conflicting bindings, an unknown include or a second unsupported currency control must retain the opaque boundary. The original/migrated source programs are preserved.
